No data
ever leaves your device

Zoned is built to run entirely locally. No analytics server, no account, no password to remember, no third-party cookies. The code is public and auditable under MIT licence.

Five questions answered upfront

01Do I need a heart rate strap?
No. You can calibrate your zones with pace (running, swimming) or power (cycling, via FTP). A heart-rate strap is useful to validate Z1–Z2 and to detect cardiac drift on long runs.
02How do I send a session to my watch?
Each session downloads as .fit (Garmin / Wahoo / COROS native workout file), .ics (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook), .pdf or .png. Generated routes export as .gpx. Every export runs locally; no file ever transits through a server.
03Can I customise a plan?
Yes. You can shift weeks (injury, travel), substitute a session (run ↔ bike ↔ swim, session ↔ strength) and move any day with drag-and-drop on the calendar. A free-form plan mode also lets you build a plan from scratch.
04Is Zoned free?
Yes, and forever. No paid tier, no locked feature, no ad banner. The project is open-source under MIT licence and funded by voluntary donations.
05What devices does Zoned run on?
Any modern browser on desktop, tablet or phone. No app to install: Zoned is a PWA, a home-screen shortcut gives you an app-like experience.
06Does Zoned work offline?
Yes. After the first load, the app and the sessions are cached by the service worker. You can open a workout, run a calculator or check your plan with no connection.
07Where is my data stored?
Everything (zones, profile, plans, favourites, routes) lives in your browser's local storage. No account, no server, no third-party cookies. You can export your data as .json from Settings to back it up or move it.
